# Bodha Research

> Bodha Research is a think tank studying contemporary cultural issues through the lens of Hindu traditions.

The organization produces research essays, long-form writing, books, digital comics, and a journal (Aryavarta). It also runs an academy with courses, a library of Sanskrit and Indic texts, an ontology drawn from the Amarakosha, and Anveshi — a program of immersive temple journeys across India.

## Core

- [Home](https://bodharesearch.in): Main site entry point for all Bodha Research content and programs.
- [About](https://www.bodharesearch.in/about): Overview of the organization's mission and approach.
- [Team](https://www.bodharesearch.in/team): Profiles of Bodha Research members and contributors.
- [Contact](https://www.bodharesearch.in/contact): Contact details and inquiry form.

## Research

- [Research](https://www.bodharesearch.in/research): Index of long-form research essays on Hindu institutions and culture.
- [Research — Hindu Frameworks of Education](https://www.bodharesearch.in/research/hindu-frameworks-of-education): Essay on Hindu models of education.
- [Research — Hindu Models of Temple Management](https://www.bodharesearch.in/research/hindu-models-of-temple-management): Essay on temple governance structures.
- [Research — Hindu Response to Enlightenment](https://www.bodharesearch.in/research/hindu-response-to-enlightenment): Essay on Hindu intellectual responses to Western Enlightenment thought.
- [Research — Hindu School of History](https://www.bodharesearch.in/research/hindu-school-of-history): Essay on Hindu historiographical traditions.
- [Research — Structure of Hindu Charity](https://www.bodharesearch.in/research/structure-of-hindu-charity): Essay on charitable frameworks in Hindu society.
- [Research — Battle for Dharma in North East](https://www.bodharesearch.in/research/battle-for-dharma-north-east): Essay on Hindu cultural challenges in Northeast India.
- [Research — Impact of Conversion in Kekadia](https://www.bodharesearch.in/research/impact-of-conversion-kekadia): Field study on conversion's effects in a specific community.
- [Research — Year in a Hajong Village](https://www.bodharesearch.in/research/year-in-hajong-village): Ethnographic study of a Hajong village.
- [Research — Temples of Madhya Pradesh](https://www.bodharesearch.in/research/temples-of-madhya-pradesh): Survey of temples in Madhya Pradesh.
- [Research — Interchanging Dynamics of Hindu Family](https://www.bodharesearch.in/research/interchanging-dynamics-of-hindu-family): Essay on shifts in Hindu family structures.
- [Research — Artist in Art](https://www.bodharesearch.in/research/artist-in-art): Essay on the role of the artist in Hindu aesthetic traditions.

## Big Questions

- [Big Questions](https://www.bodharesearch.in/big-questions): Index of essays addressing foundational questions about Hindu civilization.
- [Core of Sanatana Dharma](https://www.bodharesearch.in/big-questions/core-of-sanatana-dharma): Essay on the essential principles of Sanatana Dharma.
- [Hindu Renaissance](https://www.bodharesearch.in/big-questions/hindu-renaissance): Essay on the conditions for a Hindu cultural revival.
- [Hindu Unity and Diversity](https://www.bodharesearch.in/big-questions/hindu-unity-and-diversity): Essay on internal diversity within Hindu traditions.
- [Modernity and Hindu Values](https://www.bodharesearch.in/big-questions/modernity-and-hindu-values): Essay on tensions between modernity and Hindu values.
- [What Will Save Sanatana Dharma](https://www.bodharesearch.in/big-questions/will-save-sanatana-dharma): Essay on pathways for preserving Hindu traditions.
- [Being Indian](https://www.bodharesearch.in/big-questions/being-indian): Essay on Indian identity and civilizational belonging.
- [Hindu Institution Generate](https://www.bodharesearch.in/big-questions/hindu-institution-generate): Essay on how Hindu institutions are formed and sustained.
- [New Indian Republic](https://www.bodharesearch.in/big-questions/new-indian-republic): Essay on Hindu perspectives on the Indian republic.

- [Reading Path — Indian Knowledge Systems](https://www.bodharesearch.in/library/paths/indian-knowledge-systems): Curated reading list for Indian knowledge traditions.
- [Reading Path — History, Polity and Society](https://www.bodharesearch.in/library/paths/history-polity-and-society): Curated reading list for Hindu history and social thought.
- [Reading Path — Arts, Performance and Aesthetics](https://www.bodharesearch.in/library/paths/arts-performance-and-aesthetics): Curated reading list for Hindu arts and aesthetics.
- [Reading Path — Language, Logic and Sanskrit](https://www.bodharesearch.in/library/paths/language-logic-and-sanskrit): Curated reading list for Sanskrit and Indian logic.
- [Reading Path — Puranic and Itihasic Literature](https://www.bodharesearch.in/library/paths/puranic-and-itihasic-literature): Curated reading list for Puranas and Itihasas.
- [Reading Path — Dharma, Ethics and Law](https://www.bodharesearch.in/library/paths/dharma-ethics-and-law): Curated reading list for dharmic ethics and law.
- [Reading Path — Indology and Civilizational Critique](https://www.bodharesearch.in/library/paths/indology-and-civilizational-critique): Curated reading list for Indological and civilizational studies.
